what_landed: Tool: tools/verb_anchor.py verifies the verb kifu (mag/verb.py verify_trace: every row commits to its predecessor via ph/h), reads its tail, and commits the tail hash as ONE live anchor row in memory/biography/verkle_chain.jsonl via mag/verkle_knot.py append_verkle_knot (the locked, integrity-gated entry point).

One live row: the anchor uses the fixed session_id 'verb-anchor', so append_verkle_knot's amend-in-place path keeps it to a single chain row that is refreshed (never duplicated) as the kifu grows. Identical content skips; grown kifu amends the same row.

Row carries the binding readable straight off the chain row: dossier_commit = kifu tail hash, tension_index = 'verb_trace@<tail16> rows=N window=W', dominant_theme = 'verb_trace', start/end minute = kifu first/last ts.

Integrity: refuses to anchor an unverified kifu (breaks > 0); verkle_knot itself refuses to extend an unverified chain; after the write an O(log n) inclusion proof is built and reconstructed and the run only reports ok=True when it reaches the committed root.
Pure posture: the tool never writes to verb_trace.jsonl (a writer to both chains would rot its own anchor).
Toolbelt registration: tools/__init__.py imports verb_anchor and registers 'verb_anchor' -> anchor in TOOL_MAP and _FN.
